payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image fully look like a comic-book photo?
node.criteria: For R1, complete only if s1 passes (visible comic-book styling is present) and s2 passes (photographic subject matter and appearance are retained). Partial only if s1 passes but s2 fails or is unknown, because styling has progressed but the requested combination is incomplete. Absent if s1 fails, regardless of s2, because retained photographic appearance alone is not progress toward the requested comic-book style. Unknown if s1 is unknown; do not infer a visual failure from an execution or dependency failure. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.. Reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter..

outcome.description: Transform the image so it has a comic-book visual style while retaining its photographic subject matter.
outcome.target: The image visibly combines comic-book styling with a photographic appearance.
outcome.reference: The supplied image, as edited; assess the overall visual treatment for comic-book styling and photographic subject matter.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image remains a realistic street photograph, with no visible comic-book styling such as illustrated outlines, halftone shading, or stylized color treatment.

The edited image retains recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance: the street, vehicles, buildings, traffic light, and people remain depicted as a realistic photograph, despite some visible stylization.
